physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the skin, the body's outermost organ and its widest one, the long quiet boundary where every cell of you meets what is not you. It is where the body keeps in time with the earth, picking up the slow electromagnetic pulse the planet gives off, the low frequency the ancients called the rhythm of the ground. The skin is doing this whether or not you notice. It is listening, all day, to a beat lower than thought.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. The grey of Dullness shows up in the skin first. It goes a little dim, a little closed. The pores tighten against the air. The hairs lie flat. Whatever is meant to come in stops coming in, and whatever is meant to leave stops leaving. The body has gone behind glass. The flat hour the card describes is felt right there, in the slightly numb surface, in the strange dryness of being indoors too long in a life that has narrowed.

The climb out is also bodily, and it begins at the edge. The skin warms. The hairs lift. The boundary becomes a doorway again. Sun on the forearm, draught through a sleeve, the cold of a morning that wakes the chest. These are not extras. They are the code coming back online. The magnetism the card speaks of is not a personality trait. It is a skin that has remembered it is built to be touched by the world.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the skin, this code answers to a single amino acid, Serine. Serine is one of the small set the body makes for itself. It does not have to be brought in from outside. The cells assemble it from what is already to hand, quietly, all the time, without being told.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the heart of this card. The grey of the Shadow keeps insisting the charge must come from out there, from a new place, a new scene, a sharper edge. The chemistry says the opposite. The substance this code rests on is one the body is already making, in the dark, while you are doing nothing in particular. The magnetism is not waiting to arrive. It is being assembled. Serine sits in the membrane of every cell, the soft skin around each small life of you, the same boundary written smaller. The code runs all the way down to this. A field you do not have to go and find. A field you only have to stop interrupting.
